meta.name: self-review
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "review code", "check changes", "audit work quality", "run a self-review", "review a diff", "check for performance or efficiency problems", "look for injection or data-integrity issues", "find stale docs or broken links", or "did my change break any skills". Orchestrate comprehensive code review by launching reviewer agents in parallel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行审查代码变更，揪出质量与安全隐患
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果提交代码前想让多个审查代理自动帮你把关
copy.tagline_en: Audit code changes with parallel reviewers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automated multi-agent review before merging your code changes.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会并行启动多个审查代理检查代码改动，筛选高置信度问题并验证，最后汇总成带严重级别的报告。默认还会接着修复发现的问题，除非你要求只审查。
howto.when: 当你说“review code”“check changes”等审查请求，或直接输入 self-review 命令时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查一下当前的代码改动。
say.note: 触发并行审查并生成报告。

say.text: 检查这次改动有没有性能或效率问题。
say.note: 会针对性能问题做专项审查。

say.text: 用 self-review --diff main 审查与主分支的差异。
say.note: 只审查与 main 的差异。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude launches multiple review agents in parallel to inspect code changes, keeps only high-confidence findings, verifies each one, and produces a unified severity-rated report. By default it then hands off to fixing unless you ask it not to.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'review code' or 'check changes' (or similar review requests), or inputs the self-review command.

say_en.note: Runs parallel review and generates a report.

say_en.text: Check this change for performance or efficiency issues.
Run self-review --diff main to compare with the main branch.
say_en.note: Scopes the review to the diff against main.
